question: I am researching trends of young people leaving Wales. According to the Welsh Census 2021 and official Welsh government data, find the local authorities that did NOT see an overall decrease in amount of households since 2011. Out of these local authorities, identify those that had a population of less than 120,000 at the point of mid-year 2021 and are not in the North Wales region. From this selection, identify the all local authorities that have seen an increase of over 2% in people aged 25 to 44 between mid-year 2021 and mid-year 2022.

We need local authorities that did NOT see an overall decrease in households between 2011 and 2021. So for each local authority, compare household numbers 2011 vs 2021. We need those that stayed same or increased.

We also need those with population <120k at mid-2021 and not in North Wales.

Then among those, identify local authorities that had >2% increase in people aged 25-44 between mid-2021 and mid-2022.

Thus we need data on households 2011 and 2021 by local authority, population mid-2021 by local authority, and population aged 25-44 mid-2021 and mid-2022 by local authority. Also need region classification for North Wales.

Data sources: StatsWales dataset "Population and household estimates, England and Wales, rounded data" may contain household counts 2011 and 2021. Another dataset: mid-year population estimates (Mid-2021, Mid-2022). Also age group breakdown likely present in mid-year population estimates. We'll need to fetch those datasets.
